# Tiny League

> Benchmark scores for 44 recent small open-weight models (1.5B to 285B,
> official weights only, current versions), with 115 benchmarks, a
> sortable scores matrix, and each model's derived KV-cache cost at 128K tokens.

Tiny League is a curated league table of benchmark scores for small open-weight
language models. Scope: 1.5B to 285B total parameters, official developer-org
weights only, current versions only. 44 models and 115
benchmarks as of 2026-11-26.

## Sections

- https://tinyleague.org/models.html: one row per model with parameters, active parameters, native
  context, license, release date and derived KV-cache size at 128K tokens.
- https://tinyleague.org/matrix.html: models x benchmarks heatmap, filterable by parameter size.
- https://tinyleague.org/benchmarks.html: every benchmark grouped by domain, with coverage and leader.
- https://tinyleague.org/benchmarks/<slug>.html: one leaderboard per benchmark.
- https://tinyleague.org/compare.html: side-by-side comparison of up to five models.

## Notes

- KV @128K is derived from each model's config.json (BF16, batch 1) and verified
  against the released weights; it is not a benchmark.
- Decode speed is an estimate for one RTX 4090 at 50% of its bandwidth.
- Missing values are absent, never estimated. Versions are never pooled.
